subject.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion

question: Should Control UI configuration forms retain JavaScript-only numeric coercion, or adopt this PR's standard decimal/scientific grammar and surface the remaining spellings through existing schema validation?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but choosing which previously accepted numeric spellings remain valid in a user-facing configuration editor is an intentional compatibility policy decision.

options.title: Adopt standard numeric grammar
options.body: Accept decimal and scientific notation while preserving radix and JavaScript-only text for schema validation, as implemented by this PR.

options.title: Retain permissive coercion
options.body: Keep the existing broad `Number()` acceptance if compatibility with JavaScript-only numeric spellings is more important than preventing silent reinterpretation.

recommendation.title: Adopt standard numeric grammar
recommendation.body: Accept decimal and scientific notation while preserving radix and JavaScript-only text for schema validation, as implemented by this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is product compatibility rather than a mechanical defect.
